question: Estimate the number of pet dogs in India.
idealClarificationQuestions: Pet dogs (owned, household-kept) excluding strays? Yes.
Both pedigree + Indian breeds + indies? All household-kept dogs.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Avg dogs per pet HH: ~1.2 (some have 2).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~2.5 crore pet dogs in India.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Of these, urban + Tier 2 with disposable income for pets
Of these, having a pet dog
Rural pet HH (mostly rural-bred indies for guarding)

calculationFlow: Of these, urban + Tier 2 with disposable income for pets: ~120M.
Of these, having a pet dog: ~10% urban + 4% rural-blended.
Rural pet HH (mostly rural-bred indies for guarding): 190M × 0.04 = 7.6M.
Round: ~2.5 crore pet dogs in India.
